text:
Situation: Esomeprazole sodium is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 132 vials of 20 mg/5 mL (16.4 days) and 311 vials of 40 mg/5 mL (32.7 days). Corvale General holds 242 vials of 20 mg/5 mL (25.5 days) and 308 vials of 40 mg/5 mL (31.5 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show esomeprazole sodium is not listed on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers 16 to 33 days depending on site and strength. The rule-based best option is to buy from Eugia US LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place. Two registered plants appear on current labels: Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3002647489) with a VAI inspection ending 2024-07-25, and Hainan Poly Pharm. Co., Ltd. (FEI 3005115952) with a VAI inspection ending 2023-06-30.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer verifies whether the Eugia US LLC product can be traced to a registered plant with an acceptable inspection history before committing to purchase.
2. Buyer places purchase order with Eugia US LLC after verification; Pharmacy Director approves purchase.
3. Buyer monitors daily usage and inventory levels at both sites weekly; Pharmacy Director reviews reports.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or alternative agent substitutions at this time.
